max_transaction_ceiling_search.verdict: ABSENT in V1 — there is NO order-total ceiling that requires manager approval before a POS Operator can ring up a high-value transaction. Cash drawer reconcile DOES require manager approval beyond `cash.variance_threshold_eur` (CashVarianceRequiresApprovalException.php) — that's a DIFFERENT control (variance, not transaction ceiling).

states.owner_q_answered: Max single transaction sans manager ? — ABSENT en V1. Aucune limite de montant order qui exigerait approbation manager n'existe. adversarial_challenges.challenge: Can a newbie cashier accidentally cancel a paid kiosk order with one click?
adversarial_challenges.answer: YES — see Finding F01. cancelKioskCashOrder on PosComponent.vue:1275 fires the cancel POST directly with NO modal. Backend gate is can('pos') which POS Operator HAS. findings.title: cancelKioskCashOrder cancels a real customer-paid kiosk order with one click + no reason input + no confirmation modal
findings.details: PosComponent.vue:1275 wires a 'Annuler' button to cancelKioskCashOrder(order) which fires POST /admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/cancel with reason hard-coded client-side as 'Commande borne annulee au comptoir' (line 3174). The backend gate at routes/api.php:858 is abort_unless(auth()->user()?->can('pos'), 403) — POS Operator (newbie cashier) HAS the 'pos' permission per RolePermissionTableSeeder.php:95 and passes. No client modal, no reason capture, no 'Êtes-vous sûr ?' interstitial. Contrast with PosOrdersTrackerComponent.confirmCancelOrder which REQUIRES a reason ≥3 chars in a proper dialog (lines 304-388, validation at 813-815). A miss-tap on the small button in the kiosk-cash side-panel destroys a real order that a customer may already be standing at the borne waiting for.
findings.impact: Newbie cashier on first day can cancel a kiosk order with one tap; customer pays at borne, cashier looks at the side panel, miss-taps 'Annuler' instead of 'Encaisser', order is gone, no audit-grade reason captured (hard-coded boilerplate), no manager approval. In a busy lunch rush this is a foot-gun.
findings.fix_hint: Add either (a) reuse PosCounterCollectModal-style confirmation overlay before calling cancelKioskCashOrder — minimal scope, mirrors GREEN tracker pattern; OR (b) bring up the same tracker cancel dialog (textarea + reason ≥3) before the POST. Option (a) preferred for visual consistency with the counter-collect flow next door. Backend already idempotent (X-Idempotency-Key on the cancel route per Wave W comment lines 3160-3169) — only the UX gate is missing.

findings.title: Aucun ceiling 'max single transaction without manager' — POS Operator can confirm any amount
findings.details: Mission item 5 asked whether a newbie cashier is bounded by a max-transaction-amount that requires manager approval. Comprehensive grep across app/ + config/ for (max_transaction|transaction_limit|cashier_limit|max_ticket|order_amount_limit|sale_ceiling|over_amount) returns ZERO order-total ceilings — all 'ceiling' hits are about rate-limiting RPS or RSS/outbox/db-pool ops metrics. The discount-percentage ladder (10% / 50% / unlimited) is solid but enforces only on the discount delta, not the final order_amount. CashVarianceRequiresApprovalException exists but fires at SHIFT END reconcile (post-facto), not as a preventive gate before a 500€ POS sale.
findings.evidence: State 4 max_transaction_ceiling_search; grep across app/ + config/ returning only RPS/RSS/outbox/DB-pool ceilings
findings.impact: A newbie cashier can ring up a high-value POS transaction (e.g. catering order, comped event) without any supervisor intervention. Manager has no preventive gate; only post-shift cash-drawer reconcile would surface a variance. Common SaaS POS competitor pattern (Toast 'transactions over X require manager swipe', Square similar) is absent.
findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X backlog: add `config('pos.cashier_transaction_ceiling_eur')` (default null = no cap V1) + check in PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment or OrderQuoteService when surface=POS — if final total > ceiling AND actor lacks 'pos-confirm-over-ceiling' permission → 422 with manager-approval prompt code. Mirrors the existing discount ladder pattern. Owner-config so each Le Cayenne can tune the limit.

findings.title: Newbie cashier lands on live POS with zero first-day walkthrough; tooltips are hover-only (invisible on touch)
findings.details: LeCayenneRoleLandingUrlSeeder.php:27 maps POS Operator → 'pos' so a freshly created cashier user lands directly on /pos post-login. No tutorial component, no coachmark overlay, no onboarding library (verified: no shepherd/intro.js/driver.js in package.json — would have surfaced in import scan). The ~14 :title= tooltips and ~30 :aria-label= attrs detected in PosComponent.vue are excellent for desktop hover + assistive tech, but POS in production runs on a TOUCH screen where 'hover for hint' does not apply — newbies tap, they don't hover. PosCounterCollectModal opens directly into action with NO contextual 'how to' beyond a single static modeHint per mode (CARD/MOBILE/TICKET).
findings.impact: First-day cashier productivity loss + risk of erroneous taps (see F01). Cannot self-serve onboarding; must shadow a senior cashier. For a SaaS positioning toward 'easy to onboard new staff', this is a perception gap.
findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X UX backlog: (a) lightweight first-login coachmark on /pos using a dismissible overlay (no third-party lib needed — Vue transition + 4 step bubbles pointing at: catalog search, cart, encaisser, parked orders, history); persisted dismissal via user.preferences flag. (b) OR a 'mode démo' route /pos/?guided=1 that drops the cashier into a sandbox with sample data + step-by-step text panel. (a) is cheaper and on-brand with existing tooltip discipline.

findings.title: Trois patterns de confirmation destructive coexistent (rich modal | implicit | window.prompt) sans doctrine commune
findings.details: POS components mix three patterns: (a) RICH MODAL with reason ≥3 chars + role=dialog + danger button + error banner = PosOrdersTrackerComponent.confirmCancelOrder (GREEN reference); (b) IMPLICIT no-confirm = PosComponent.cancelKioskCashOrder + cancelLastCartLine; (c) NATIVE window.prompt = FloorplanComponent.vue:249 ('message.confirm_transfer' — note V1 dine-in is feature-flag OFF per CLAUDE.md memory so this is dormant but the inconsistent pattern remains in the code). No 'Êtes-vous sûr ?' idiom anywhere — the FR safety phrasing tradition is unused in favor of action-verb confirmations.
findings.impact: Newbie cashier learns one pattern (tracker dialog) and is then surprised when kiosk-cash cancel destroys directly. Long-term: pattern-drift makes onboarding cost compound (each new screen learned independently).
findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X UX backlog: doctrine 'tout cancel d\'order = modal-with-reason ≥3 chars'. Refactor cancelKioskCashOrder to reuse a shared `<ConfirmCancelOrderDialog />` extracted from PosOrdersTrackerComponent. Retire window.prompt branch in FloorplanComponent before V1.0.2 enables dine-in. Mantra: ONE confirm doctrine, applied everywhere.

findings.title: PosCounterCollectModal n'aide pas le cashier débutant à choisir / vérifier — feedback minimal
findings.details: Le modal expose 4 modes (CASH/CARD/MOBILE/TICKET) avec icône + label + optionally une sub-key (cc_mode_card_hint pour les non-CASH modes). MAIS: (a) pas d'exemple 'CASH = espèces / billets reçus en main', (b) cc_cash_short alert dit juste 'label.cc_cash_short' générique sans préciser combien manque (e.g. devrait dire 'Il manque 2,50€'), (c) le rendu (cashChange) s'affiche bien avec ✨ icon et role=status + aria-live=polite (très bien!) mais aucune indication 'donner ce montant au client en pièces/billets' — newbie ne sait pas que rendu = donner monnaie. Les keyboard shortcuts (Esc/Enter/auto-focus/auto-prefill total) sont excellents mais invisibles tant qu'on ne les a pas vus une fois.
findings.impact: Augmente le temps d'apprentissage modal pour un newbie; risque mineur d'erreur (e.g. donner trop de monnaie si rendu mal lu). Modal est solide mais 'paufiné' pour expert, pas 'guidant' pour débutant.
findings.fix_hint: V1.0.X microcopy backlog: (a) ajouter `Il manque {{ formatPrice(orderTotal - cashReceivedNumber) }}` à la place de label.cc_cash_short statique; (b) ajouter une ligne hint 'À rendre au client : {{ formatPrice(cashChange) }}' (déjà calculé par cashChange computed); (c) micro-tooltip first-use 'Astuce: appuyez Entrée pour valider' au-dessus du Numpad ; persistée dismissed.

scores.verdict_short: YELLOW — Backend RBAC GREEN (10% discount cap + destroy-paid gate ironclad). UX safety newbie PATCHY (1 P0 one-click cancel + 2 P1 gaps + 2 P2 drift).

top_3_findings_summary: P0 B2-P6-F01: cancelKioskCashOrder cancels a real customer-paid kiosk order with ONE CLICK — no modal, no reason capture, backend RBAC is just can('pos') which POS Operator has. Newbie miss-tap = destroyed customer order. Fix: reuse tracker-style modal + reason ≥3.

P1 B2-P6-F02: No 'max single transaction without manager' ceiling — POS Operator can confirm any amount (5€ or 5000€). Only discount %ge ladder + post-shift variance gate exist. Common SaaS competitor pattern missing.
P1 B2-P6-F03: Newbie cashier lands on live /pos with ZERO first-day walkthrough; ~14 tooltips + ~30 aria-labels are hover-only and invisible on touch hardware where POS actually runs.
